mechanism: On pc_run1c primary failure at exactly p=ls+1, probe the previous output match distance once. Reuse out[nt-1] rather than a new table/state variable; original successful primary and deepening path is preserved. No chain deepening follows a rescued match.
difference_from_old_work: A bounded conditional revisit of R11 gaprepeat, which reduced size 0.0222624pp but cost 0.850916% total time on fast3. Old code tried all failed-probe positions with any pending literal gap; this permits one position per inter-match literal run, excludes long miss stretches, and operates on actual595 pc_run1c. R13 predecessor rescue instead retries hash-collision chains; this probes a distance independent of the hash chain. It is not claimed as an entirely new repeat-distance mechanism.

attribution.ownership: Inherited public PC matcher, original routing and original author headers retained.

proof_migration: Add pc_f_find_gap1_spec returning FoundAt plus length<=258 and distance<=32768. Reuse probe_m_spec, f_deepen_spec, FoundAt.real and MatchAt bounds. Arbitrary out token is a hint and needs no decoded-token invariant; guards establish safe read and rc<=p. No main-loop tuple field or Rust loop parameter added, but actual extraction must be checked. Inherited Lean does not yet contain the helper theorem.
